series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits high unpredictability (spectral entropy 0.93) and concept drift, with significant model performance variance. Baseline strategies with robust median aggregation are recommended to handle the unstable environment and high noise levels, avoiding complex stacking methods.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true AND spectral_entropy=0.9287 → robust_median handles high noise and near-white-noise series (Goerg 2013)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.25) → inverse weighting with shrinkage (0.35) mitigates unstable rankings (Genre et al. 2013)
reasoning.topk_mean_per_horizon_k4: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon top-k averaging captures differentiated model performance across horizons (Timmermann 2006)
reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance (Gaillard & Goude 2015)

excluded_highlights.baseline_mean: series_profile.combination_recommendation.method_hint=robust_median (not baseline_mean) AND noise.unpredictable=true (baseline_mean sensitive to outliers)
excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking AND n_windows=2 (ridge overfits with few windows)
